title: Differential brain mechanisms of selection and maintenance of information during working memory (MEG data)
description: MEG dataset from 22 participants performing a visual working memory task in which two Gabor stimuli were presented and a retro-cue indicated which stimulus and attribute to maintain for comparison with a probe. Each participant was recorded in two MEG sessions, with a one-back control task and anatomical T1 MRI. The data support investigation of the distinct brain mechanisms of selecting and maintaining information in working memory.
methods_description: MEG was recorded across two sessions per participant at the NIH MEG facility. Participants performed a working memory task (WorkMem) with Gabor stimuli varying in spatial frequency, orientation and phase, and a one-back control task (LocaCue). Stimuli were presented with Psychtoolbox 3 in Matlab, with eye fixation monitored. Head position indicator coordinates were acquired with the Brainsight neuronavigation system and registered to T1 MRI.
